title.en: Any number of drawers in turn
title.zh: 任意多个轮流的抽取者

statement.en: With any number of drawers in turn from two, each ranking courses, every profile at a mutual best response at every step from every level has every drawer leave nothing, so the base stands at once at what stands at nothing; two drawers are the case.
statement.zh: 两个及以上任意多个各自对过程排序的轮流抽取者，每步、每个水平都处于相互最优回应的每个组合中每者都不留，故基底立即立于零处所立者；两个抽取者是其情形。

laws.en: At each step k drawers draw in turn, each leaving part of what it is given to the next; a profile is perfect where each leaves at most what it is given and every drawer, of whatever it is given, leaves what draws it the most.
laws.zh: 每步 k 个抽取者轮流抽取，各自把所给的一部分留给下一者；若各自至多留所给，且每者对所给都留下使自己抽取最多者，组合即完美。

laws.en: With at least two drawers, backward from the horizon every drawer after the first draws nothing later and leaves nothing, and then so does the first: every perfect profile has every drawer leave nothing at every step, the base standing at what stands at nothing.
laws.zh: 两个及以上抽取者时，自视野逆推，第一者之后的每者此后不抽而全不留，于是第一者亦然：每个完美组合中每者每步都不留，基底立于零处所立者。

laws.en: Drawing everything is perfect for every number of drawers from two.
laws.zh: 全部抽取对两个及以上任意多个抽取者都是完美的。

laws.en: Two drawers are the case k = 2: their draws, levels and perfect profiles are those of drawers 0 and 1, and their laws are derived from these.
laws.zh: 两个抽取者是 k = 2 的情形：其所抽、水平与完美组合即抽取者 0 与 1 的，其律由此导出。

laws.en: On a web, along every perfect profile of two or more drawers a dependence above what stands at nothing is broken at the first step; under the gate, every perfect profile of any number from two breaks the dweller.
laws.zh: 在网上，沿两个及以上抽取者的每个完美组合，高于零处所立者的依存在第一步被打破；门控下，两个及以上任意多个的每个完美组合都打破居者。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. SG14's model: any law G of what stands; k drawers in turn at each step, k at least two; plain sums over the steps that remain; rules reading the drawer, the step and the level; each leaving at most what it is given, with no capacity limit; natural amounts, discrete steps.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。SG14 的模型：任一所立之律 G；每步 k 个轮流的抽取者，k 至少为二；其后各步之和；规则读取抽取者、步与水平；各自至多留所给，无容量限制；自然数量，离散步。

does_not_show.en: Drawers drawing at once with a rule of sharing; capacities limiting the draws of more than two drawers.
does_not_show.zh: 按分享规则同时抽取的抽取者；限制多于两个抽取者之抽取的容量。

does_not_show.en: One drawer: with k = 1 an optimum may keep the base (Holding.gated_in_turn).
does_not_show.zh: 一个抽取者：k = 1 时最优可保持基底（Holding.gated_in_turn）。

does_not_show.en: That the drain is a harm or restraint better: no evaluation enters; the laws say what perfect profiles do.
does_not_show.zh: 抽干是伤害或克制更好：没有评价进入；这些律只说完美组合做什么。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261022T040548.209667Z): the 21 declarations Becoming.Optimum gained have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Built and reviewed in one session; author review in study section 332; not independently reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261022T040548.209667Z）：Becoming.Optimum 新增的 21 项声明公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。在一个会话中构建并审查；作者审查见研究第 332 节；未经人的独立审查。

next_delta.en: Drawing at once with a rule of sharing; capacities for more drawers; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 按分享规则同时抽取；更多抽取者的容量；独立审查。

correspondence.en: In the n-player dynamic commons the equilibrium stock falls as players are added (Levhari and Mirman 1980); backward induction in finite games of perfect information (Selten 1965).
correspondence.zh: 在 n 人动态公地中，均衡存量随参与者增加而下降（Levhari 与 Mirman 1980）；有限完美信息博弈中的逆向归纳（Selten 1965）。

detail.en: Its two drawers are the case k = 2; its web law is derived from these, its step laws, perfect_ends and perfect_levels removed; its open item on more than two drawers is answered.
detail.zh: 其两个抽取者是 k = 2 的情形；其网律由此导出，其步律、perfect_ends 与 perfect_levels 被移除；回答其关于多于两个抽取者的开放项。
